grammar_tips.title: Conversations
grammar_tips.explanation: Now write short conversations and self-descriptions using question words, negation, connectors and frequency adverbs. Mix what you've learned freely.

prompt.text: Write 4 questions you could ask a new friend (one with each: dove, cosa, quando, perché).

exercises.correct_answer: Dove abiti? Cosa studi? Quando lavori? Perché impari l'italiano?
hints: Use different question words. Keep it short.

prompt.text: Say three things you DON'T do. Use 'non' (3 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Non parlo francese. Non mangio carne. Non lavoro il sabato.

prompt.text: Describe how often you do three things. Use sempre/spesso/qualche volta/mai/raramente (3 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Studio italiano ogni giorno. Vado spesso al cinema. Non mangio mai la carne.

prompt.text: Talk about a habit and an exception — use 'ma' or 'però' (2-3 sentences).

exercises.correct_answer: Mangio sempre a casa, ma qualche volta vado al ristorante. Studio ogni giorno, però il sabato mi riposo.
